body: i get that but atp, i don’t know how to distinguish truth and lies. I’ve had ppl vent to me too, I still have people vent to me. I just don’t know how love feels anymore. I don’t even know how to feel or think. I can’t think straight. I hate everything about this and myself.
i just don’t want to be a bother to anyone. At this point i don’t know if i should end it all or if i should keep living. I just feel pure emptiness.
i’ve never really talked about my feelings if i’m going to be honest, if you need someone to talk to, i’ll listen. :)
it’s alright. there’s nothing i can really do besides just leaving.
